candidates.title: Featured article flag appears and is removed from the featured list
candidates.preconditions: Unfeatured published article with unique title; featured-list baseline empty for that title.
candidates.fixture: Toggle featured on, reload list, then toggle off.

oracle.observable: Article appears exactly once in featured list while enabled and disappears when disabled; article record remains published.

novelty.rationale: Baseline creates/edits/archives articles and categories, but does not assert featured-list membership.

baselineOverlap.rationale: Baseline creates/edits/archives articles and categories, but does not assert featured-list membership.
baselineOverlap.comparisonBasis: T04-D pinned Gherkin and Java mapping index; structural mapping is not treated as semantic proof.

candidates.negativeControl: Use a published but unfeatured article and verify it remains outside the featured list.
candidates.testabilityRisk: Feature visibility can depend on front-end menu configuration.
candidates.uncertainty: Model updates the featured table and featured query filters by flag/state/access; public rendering remains configuration-dependent.
candidates.historicalComparison: No prior candidate index entry is treated as a human novelty decision.
candidates.action: Exercise: Featured article flag appears and is removed from the featured list.

candidates.title: Publish-up and publish-down define the article visibility window
candidates.preconditions: Published article with start/end timestamps in a controlled timezone; unique alias.
candidates.fixture: Set future publish-up and future publish-down, then inspect before, within and after the window.

oracle.observable: Article is hidden before start, visible during the window, and hidden after end.

novelty.rationale: Baseline Add/Edit Article and Archive Article cases do not assert timed visibility boundaries.

baselineOverlap.rationale: Baseline Add/Edit Article and Archive Article cases do not assert timed visibility boundaries.
baselineOverlap.comparisonBasis: T04-D pinned Gherkin and Java mapping index; structural mapping is not treated as semantic proof.

candidates.negativeControl: Keep a normal published article as a control at each observation time.
candidates.testabilityRisk: Timezone, cache and server clock can make boundaries flaky.
candidates.uncertainty: Source listing exposes publish_up/down and model assigns publish dates; actual front-end boundary behavior requires runtime check.
candidates.historicalComparison: No prior candidate index entry is treated as a human novelty decision.
candidates.action: Exercise: Publish-up and publish-down define the article visibility window.

candidates.title: Editor without edit-state permission cannot change publication state
candidates.role: Editor lacks core.edit.state; admin has it
candidates.preconditions: Two accounts with same article access but different ACL; article is checked in.
candidates.fixture: Attempt to unpublish as editor, then as administrator.

oracle.observable: Editor cannot persist state change and receives an authorization outcome; administrator can perform the change.

novelty.rationale: Baseline user/group and article CRUD cases do not verify an authorization denial on state changes.

baselineOverlap.rationale: Baseline user/group and article CRUD cases do not verify an authorization denial on state changes.
baselineOverlap.comparisonBasis: T04-D pinned Gherkin and Java mapping index; structural mapping is not treated as semantic proof.

candidates.negativeControl: Admin control confirms the test target is otherwise editable.
candidates.testabilityRisk: ACL setup and cached sessions need clean users.
candidates.uncertainty: Model's `canEditState` checks `core.edit.state`; UI messaging and effective role mapping require reviewer/runtime verification.
candidates.historicalComparison: No prior candidate index entry is treated as a human novelty decision.
candidates.action: Exercise: Editor without edit-state permission cannot change publication state.

candidates.title: Editing an article increments its version counter
candidates.preconditions: Existing article with known version counter and history enabled.
candidates.fixture: Edit and save a single field, then reload version/history information.

oracle.observable: Version counter increases once for one successful save and remains unchanged after a rejected save.

novelty.rationale: Baseline EditArticle overlaps the edit operation but does not explicitly assert version increment/history state.

baselineOverlap.rationale: Baseline EditArticle overlaps the edit operation but does not explicitly assert version increment/history state.
baselineOverlap.comparisonBasis: T04-D pinned Gherkin and Java mapping index; structural mapping is not treated as semantic proof.

candidates.negativeControl: Submit an invalid edit and verify version does not increment.
candidates.testabilityRisk: Displayed version/history UI may require Joomla content-history configuration.
candidates.uncertainty: Source model increments the article version on save; UI history visibility is a separate uncertainty.
candidates.historicalComparison: No prior candidate index entry is treated as a human novelty decision.
candidates.action: Exercise: Editing an article increments its version counter.
